# Airborne F2 190

**Prototype:** Airborne F2 · **years:** years unknown · **group:** [Trainers](/wings/trainer/) · **kingposted**

![Model of the Airborne F2 190 in the game (Blender render)](/docs/models/screenshots/glider_air_f2/iso45.jpg)

## Data

Numbers are as in the game (`configs/wings/air_f2.json`). Marks: **passport**, **analog**, **estimate** — [what they mean](/wings/#provenance-marks).

| Parameter | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Span | 10.1 m | **passport**: [Airborne F2 manual (PDF)](https://www.airborne.com.au/images/manuals/8439.pdf) “WING SPAN 10.1 m” |
| Area | 17.7 m² | **passport**: [Airborne F2 manual (PDF)](https://www.airborne.com.au/images/manuals/8439.pdf) “SAIL AREA 17.7 sq meter” |
| Wing mass | 23 kg | **passport**: [Airborne F2 manual (PDF)](https://www.airborne.com.au/images/manuals/8439.pdf) “GLIDER WEIGHT 23 kg” |
| Pilot mass with hang point | 70–120 kg | **passport**: [Airborne F2 manual (PDF)](https://www.airborne.com.au/images/manuals/8439.pdf) “RECOMMENDED PILOT HOOK IN WEIGHT RANGE 70-120 kg” |
| Double surface | 30 % of span | **passport**: [Airborne F2 manual (PDF)](https://www.airborne.com.au/images/manuals/8439.pdf) “DOUBLE SURFACE % 30 %” |
| Kingpost | yes (kingposted) | **estimate**: by year of production and class, no confirming quote (3D model spec, section N3) |
| Class / certification | HGMA/USHPA II Novice | **passport**: [Airborne F2 manual (PDF)](https://www.airborne.com.au/images/manuals/8439.pdf) |
| Years of production | unknown | **estimate**: not in the passports or the sample |
| Trim speed | 31.1 km/h | **estimate**: game model: polar of the base Wills Wing Falcon 170 scaled by wing loading (f = 1.0022) |
| Speed, control frame fully pulled in | 60.1 km/h | **estimate**: game model: polar of the base Wills Wing Falcon 170 scaled by wing loading (f = 1.0022) |
| Stall (straight flight) | 24.1 km/h | **estimate**: game model: polar of the base Wills Wing Falcon 170 scaled by wing loading (f = 1.0022) |
| Minimum sink | 1.002 m/s at 30.1 km/h | **estimate**: game model: polar of the base Wills Wing Falcon 170 scaled by wing loading (f = 1.0022) |
| Glide ratio | 9 at 38.1 km/h | **estimate**: game model: polar of the base Wills Wing Falcon 170 scaled by wing loading (f = 1.0022); scaling does not change the glide ratio — same as the base |
| Wind at launch | trainer, 7–10 m/s | **estimate**: class by crossbar, class limit per the pilot (configs/wing_classes.json); a game menu hint, not used in the physics |
| Reference pilot mass (for the polar) | 92 kg | **estimate**: game model: same place in the range as the base Wills Wing Falcon 170 |
